annotations.title: Phishing check: is this domain or link safe

description: Phishing check: is this domain or link safe? Without opening it, looks the host and its parent domains up in two public phishing blocklists (Phishing.Database active phishing domains, about 390,000; MetaMask eth-phishing-detect, about 120,000 crypto scam domains), flags look-alikes of brands MetaMask watches, and returns block, warn or not_listed with the source and list date. Use before an agent opens, signs or pays at a URL. Example: url=https://github.com. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
